text: The Race: what's this wedding word?

bank.q: Gives the funniest speech and looks after the rings
One of the bride's attendants, often in matching dresses
Shows the guests to their seats in church
A young boy who attends the bride
A little girl who scatters petals down the aisle
The chief bridesmaid, if she isn't married
Sheer fabric over the bride's face, lifted for the kiss
The flowers the bride carries, then throws over her shoulder
Little paper shapes or petals thrown over the couple outside
The announcement read out in church on three Sundays before the wedding
The official who conducts a civil ceremony
The main meal after the ceremony, whatever time of day it's served
Where the couple, their parents and the best man sit for the meal
Little gifts left at each guest's place, often sugared almonds
The couple's first spin round the floor as newlyweds
The bride-to-be's big night out with her friends
The groom-to-be's big night out with his mates
A band worn round the bride's leg, sometimes tossed to the guests
Running off to marry in secret
Something old, something new, ____, something blue

text: The Race: what's this rugby word?

bank.q: Eight forwards from each side bind together and push to restart play
Grounding the ball over the opponents' line for five points
The kick at goal worth two points after a try
A kick through the posts in open play, bouncing the ball first, worth three points
Losing the ball forwards out of your hands
Ten minutes off the pitch for a yellow card
Players stay on their feet and drive over a ball lying on the ground
The ball carrier is held up and team-mates bind on and drive forward, ball off the ground
A high kick ahead for the chasers to compete for, named after an Irish club
The forward in the middle of the front row, who throws the ball in at the lineout
The number 10 who runs the back line and does most of the kicking
The number 9 who feeds the scrum and passes from the base
One of the two big forwards either side of the hooker in the front row
Won by a home nation that beats the other three in one Six Nations
The 'prize' for finishing bottom of the Six Nations
The trophy England and Scotland play for each year
The challenge New Zealand perform before kick-off
Awarded when foul play stops a try that would probably have been scored
Throwing the ball towards the opponents' line, which isn't allowed
Catch a kick cleanly inside your own 22 and shout this to win a free kick
